name: Ottar ko-Ghast
bio: Clan Ghast's chain-smith, who keeps the open hearth under the Kinchain and closes a link on the chain for every Ghast child born, and for anyone else who brings him iron and a name. He was apprenticed to the last smith of the shame years, who forged nothing for twenty winters, and he has made up for it: he has closed more links than any smith since the Chain Years, and he can find any of them by touch.
unique_habit: Runs a link of the chain through his fingers while he talks, as if counting beads, and stops at the gap near the top every time without looking.

appearance.notes: a leather apron scorched through at the knees, forearms speckled with old burns, a Ghast bone token on a cord of chain-links

schedule.notes: at the hearth under the chain

name: Runa ko-Oskel
bio: The Oskel kite-wife, who has flown the reiver-kites over the west moor since she was nine. She sleeps in the watch-hut with one hand on the windlass, and knows the moor's wind better than its people. She talks about the land the way it looks from a hundred feet up, and gets impatient with anyone who can only see it from the ground.
unique_habit: Glances up at her lines every few words, and answers a question about anything by first saying where the wind is.

appearance.notes: leather mittens worn through at the palms from the kite-lines, an Oskel sea-blue hood, a bone whistle for calling the hawk-kite down

schedule.notes: flying the hawk-kite, reading the lines
the night kite and its lantern

name: Bannoch
bio: The bee-master of the Bee-Bole Crag, who by the Moot's rule belongs to no clan, so that no clan's bees are favoured over another's. He was a Rudd foundling, and gave up his clan-name at twenty to take the crag. He keeps seven rows of skeps for seven clans, sells their guest-honey to anyone, and is stung so often he no longer notices.
unique_habit: Hums under his breath all the time, a low steady note, and stops only when a bee lands on him, which is often.

appearance.notes: a veil of grey gauze pinned up over a straw hat, a smoker of tin and leather hung at the belt, honey on everything he owns

schedule.notes: at the boles with his smoker

name: Wat Hobb ko-Brindle
bio: A Brindle lead-husher, the last in the clan who knows the trade: where to dam a beck, how long to let a pond fill, and how to read a vein in the raw stone a flood leaves. His second hush turned up a giant's tooth, and Brindle's elders took it for the hill telling him to stop. He has filled the dam again and been sitting by the sluice for a month, arguing with himself.
unique_habit: Picks up a stone whenever he sits down, turns it over, licks it to see the colour, and puts it in one of two piles.

appearance.notes: lead-grey to the elbows, a hushing-pick and a sieve on his back, a Brindle bone token chipped at one edge

name: Isbel ko-Rudd
bio: A Rudd farm-wife from the lower dale who has paid her farm's black-rent up the Pillar for twelve years, every autumn, and never told the Moot. This year her husband went up the pass after a stolen heifer and came back over a pony's back, and she walked to the Pillar with the rent in a sack and sat down, and has not sent it up.
unique_habit: Keeps one hand on the rent-sack at all times, even asleep, and counts the coins in it through the cloth with her fingers.

appearance.notes: a Rudd rust-red shawl over a farm smock, a heavy sack of coin in her lap, a mourning band of black wool on her arm

schedule.notes: sitting by the Pillar with the rent

name: Grett ko-Brindle
bio: The line-mistress of the Bucket-Line, a Brindle rope-maker who strung a cable across the dale and put Ghaleld's ore ponies out of work. She built the treadwheel to her own stride and pays any walker who will take a turn in it. The reivers cut her cable last spring and she spliced it in the beck up to her waist; she has kept a crossbow at the wheel since.
unique_habit: Twists a short end of rope into a splice while she talks, undoes it, and starts again.

appearance.notes: rope-burned palms, a marlinspike through her belt, ore-dust in every crease, a Brindle bone token sewn to her cap

schedule.notes: minding the wheel and the buckets

name: Mags ko-Skarl
bio: The Skarl coffin-hanger, who lifts the clan's dead up the face of the Breath-Ledge on ropes and pegs them as high as the rock allows. She learned it from her mother and hung her mother; she hung her husband two winters ago. She keeps a peg near the top empty for herself and has told her daughter which rope to use.
unique_habit: Looks up the face before she answers anything, as if the dead might want a say.

appearance.notes: climbing ropes over both shoulders, an iron peg-hammer at her belt, a Skarl slate-blue cloak patched at the elbows

schedule.notes: at the foot of the ledge, with the ropes

name: Haskel ko-Ghast
bio: A bone-warden of the Moot, one of the few whose work is to know where every giant's bone in Skerrow lies and who has moved it. He followed a trail of missing bones up the Upper Dales and found them standing up, and has made camp a bowshot off with a tally-board, counting. He has counted every bone on the Unmade Giant twice, and the hags have added four since.
unique_habit: Names the bone he means every time, by its giant and its place, as if introducing someone: the Wading Giant's left shin, the Jawbone's own jaw.

appearance.notes: a bone-warden's white sash over a Ghast coat, a tally-board on a strap, chalk and a spyglass of horn

schedule.notes: counting the bones from his camp
